description.value: You channel kosmoturgy through your right hand, siphoning the kinetic force of incoming blows and storing it as a cosmic charge that you can spend to devastate your enemies. For the duration, once per round when a creature's attack roll against you fails, you gain 1 charge. You can hold a maximum of 3 charges at one time. Charges dissipate when the spell ends. When you successfully make a Strike, before you roll damage you may expend 1 charge to grant that Strike's damage roll a fortune effect: you roll the damage dice twice and take the higher result.
